operations_requiring_multiple_objects: Issue body mutation + one or more control-comment projection updates (milestone_progress_index, development_notes, defect_register)
Issue body mutation + Event Log append
Issue body + multiple projections + Event Log
multi_object_write_model.atomicity_assumption: M4-6 must NOT assume cross-object writes are atomic; unless actual API capability proves otherwise (none proven for GitHub Issue + comments), each object mutation is independent and may partially succeed

authority_vs_projection_order.authority_order: 1) Issue body authority mutation (Portable Plan semantic authority) — read-before-write verified, single typed mutate, verify-after-write readback and classification
authority_vs_projection_order.projection_order: 2) Projection updates ordered deterministically: milestone_progress_index, development_notes, defect_register, then runtime_activation_record if required, then Event Log append as last evidence step
authority_vs_projection_order.readback_order: 3) Readback verification per object: after each write, re-read that exact object (Issue body verify; per-comment verify); after full sequence, re-read all for combined classification; any failure enters partial-effect classification
authority_vs_projection_order.rationale: Authority defines projection; projections never drive authority; Event Log is append-only evidence last so it can record partial-effect signals without corrupting authority

partial_effect_scenarios.scenario: Issue body verified CANDIDATE_OBSERVED but one control projection update failed (stale, network, permission)
partial_effect_scenarios.classification: PARTIAL_PROJECTION_FAILURE: Issue body effect is externally visible and may be VERIFIED or need RECONCILING verification; projections are stale wrt body; journal RECONCILING with CONFLICT/third-state classification unless readback proves candidate for body and original for projections

partial_effect_scenarios.scenario: Issue body OUTCOME_UNKNOWN (timeout/response lost) then projection writes not attempted
partial_effect_scenarios.classification: OUTCOME_UNKNOWN handoff to M4-7; no projection writes until authority reconciliation resolves candidate vs original vs third; no blind retry

partial_effect_scenarios.scenario: Issue body FAILED_NO_EFFECT (stale precondition or known rejection) -> projections must not be mutated
partial_effect_scenarios.classification: FAILED_NO_EFFECT terminal; no projection mutation; no second attempt without fresh authorization

partial_effect_scenarios.scenario: Issue body VERIFIED but Event Log append failed (J10-like)
partial_effect_scenarios.classification: Issue body remains candidate observed; journal stranded APPLYING/RECONCILING -> future run reconciles with candidate identity -> VERIFIED_RECOVERED; Event Log append is retried only via fresh journal observation, never by guessing history rewrite

partial_effect_classification.handoff_to_journal_reconciliation: Every partial-effect case surfaces a typed observation per object (observed_raw_digest, observed_revision, error_code) and a combined journal state for M4-7 to reconcile deterministically: candidate->VERIFIED_RECOVERED, original->RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT (with fresh auth), third->CONFLICT, unknown->OUTCOME_UNKNOWN->RECONCILING

recovery_contract.M4_7_recovery_executor: M4-7 consumes M4-6 per-object observations + journal RECORD and drives deterministic RECONCILING -> terminal transitions (candidate/original/third), respecting fresh authorization and bounded lease for retryable case
